svg.title: Heap sort complete trace including build heap and extract max phases
svg.desc: Shows building a max heap from [4,10,3,5,1] then repeatedly extracting max to produce sorted array
svg.text: Phase 1 — Build Max Heap (heapify from bottom up, starting at last non-leaf = index 1)
Phase 2 — Extract Max repeatedly (swap root with last, reduce heap size, re-heapify)
O(n log n) time · O(1) space (in-place!) · Not stable
Build heap O(n) + n extractions × O(log n) each
